summary: Round 41 recheck, 14:14-14:35Z 29 Sep (17:14-17:35 MSK). Sources: local files and three local arithmetic checks. 0 Kaggle calls, no browser, nothing built or submitted. The lens is saturated (~150 earlier items, R2-R40). Before picking, I grepped every earlier recheck and dropped five candidates as duplicates: DivNet re-rank (R8-RC-B), relink OFF (R9-RC-B), the (g)13 block split (R30-RC-B), C10/thtennant (R30-RC-C) and the OOF edge scorer (retrain family, R33-RC-B). The three picks are the old conclusions that the two newest facts touch: the private-risk audit with its skeptic (13:21Z) and user decision B (13:34Z), which postdate all rounds. (A) v3 R4 / (f): a node-set changer needs +0.002 to enter F1, and 0/+0.001 makes it only an F2 candidate. Decision B promotes exp89t (DIS 2.25 = a node-set changer, -0.77% nodes) at +0.001 (0.960). DECISION B UPHELD. R4's +0.002 was lifted for the public slot on 26 Sep 21:31Z (L9). A 0.960 read implies public DIS of about +0.00075 (exp87a sits ~0.95875 unrounded, 17th of 22). That is at least the mechanical node term (+0.0005..+0.0007), so the promotion has a private expectation >= 0. Keeping exp87a at 0.959 costs at most ~0.0005 and is ~0 in expectation, because the 48-video lab puts DIS 2.25 at -0.0007. (B) v3 (i), 'READMIT_MIN_SCORE knob closed (-0.0015..+0.0007)', read against the audit's harsh scenario (K centred at -0.001 as a 'public-only' lever): THE AUDIT LABEL IS HALF WRONG, and the closure stays overturned. Almost all of K is READMIT 0.94 (+1,022 nodes; ILP 0.4 alone is +49 nodes / +3 forks). Its node cost of -0.0008 is mechanical and transfers. Its recall side exists only on unseen embryos, and the public embryo is one of those (R23-RC-A). So the harsh -0.001 is K's floor (zero recall gain), not its centre. Nothing changes for the pair: neither П3 nor П2 carries K, and {exp75, #37} (the pair without cap 6 and K) moves further out. (C) v3 R2, 'insertion stays in F1 on a tie; private break-even 0.11-0.20 < 0.265 public', against the skeptic's correction (the OOF +0.0019 is from an older config and failed its 31% gate at 4/15 = 27%): UPHELD. The 31% gate was the PUBLIC floor. On the lab-J break-even q* = 0.161, a Beta(5,12) posterior gives P(precision < q*) = 0.10 and P(< 0.20) = 0.20. The insertion stays in every final, and #38 stays out. No rechecked item gives a build, a dummy, a slot use or a pair change. The reserve slot is past its 14:10Z default edge (R40-A1). Tonight's chain (T-codes, 18:37Z card, SELECTED checks) is unchanged.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: v3 FINAL_REPORT (e) R4. A changer of the node or fork set (DeepCenter threshold, tempfuse, leaf prune, successors, readmit knobs) enters F1 at +0.002 or more. At 0 or +0.001 it is only an F2 candidate, and it is never accepted on a lab gain alone. v3 (f) adds that F1 = the most complete build whose riders each passed R3/R4. EVIDENCE then: LB noise was considered unresolved below 0.002, and node/fork levers had flipped sign by embryo. WHAT CHANGED: (1) The user lifted R4's +0.002 for the PUBLIC-aimed slot on 26 Sep 21:31Z (CONTEXT l.2502-2505: 'replaced by L9's display >= 0.955'). The kernels are deterministic, so a 0.001 display step is a real effect on the public embryo. (2) DECISION B (13:34Z) promotes exp89t (K + DIS 2.25 + CI) over exp87a only at >= 0.960 (+0.001). DIS is a node-set changer: exp89t has 121,389 nodes vs exp87a's 122,328 (-0.77%), with topology identical to exp89s. So B uses a +0.001 bar for an R4-class lever. (3) New numbers. The node term alone, adj = J*(1 - 0.1*dN/N_est) with J ~0.91, gives DIS +0.0007; the dummy lab measured +0.00048 for this part (R38-A2 INFO). The 48-video exp13 parabola (R26-RC-A) puts DIS 2.25 at -0.0007 net: it costs 83 readmits and 26 gap closes. exp87a is 17th of 22 in the 0.959 block (e10 11:41Z; Chrome 13:20Z the same). If scores are uniform within the block, its unrounded score is ~0.95875, so exp89t needs public DIS >= ~+0.00075 (range 0 to +0.001) to display 0.960. NEW VERDICT: DECISION B UPHELD; R4's +0.002 is not needed. A 0.960 read means public DIS is at least the mechanical node term. The node term transfers to any embryo, and the edge residual is small (0 to +0.0003), so the private expectation of the swap is ~+0.0004..+0.0006 (>= 0). At 0.959, public DIS lies in about [-0.0003, +0.00075). Given the two labs (+0.0005 vs -0.0007), the private expectation is ~0 +- 0.0007. Keeping exp87a costs at most ~0.0005 and nothing on average, so B's keep is sound. Under v3 R4 a 0.960 exp89t would have been only an 'F2 candidate'. That role no longer exists: the partner slot is the lever-free hedge (R34-RC-C). SUB-CHECK T2 (a late 0.960 read, header 19:12:17-19:45:17Z, UNPROVEN-ins). exp89t's expected L is 9.28-9.48 h, and P(L > 10.2 h) is small (all CI files 8.88-9.48 h). Even so, P(0.960 and late) is <= ~1%. That is too small to justify a pre-registered carve-out now, and adding one would be post-hoc.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: v3 FINAL_REPORT (i): 'READMIT_MIN_SCORE knob in F1: failed readmits are linked (479 of 513 leaves), -0.0015..+0.0007' (v_metric-math_readmit-recall-knobs_value.json). R23-RC-A overturned the REASON: the lab cannot see this knob. K (ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT 0.94) then read +0.002 on public (probe 50, UP 21), and V_pub exp87a carries it. The 13:21Z private-risk audit filed K with cap 6 as a 'public-only' lever: its harsh scenario centres both at -0.001 (pair {exp87a, #37} bronze ~0.56 / silver ~0.19), and it priced {exp75, #37} as paying only if P(cap 6 and K both clearly negative) > ~45%. WHAT CHANGED / FRESH CHECK: (1) The decomposition (CONTEXT l.3485-3490) shows K is almost entirely READMIT. exp85c (READMIT 0.94 alone) has +1,022 nodes (+0.84%) and LOWREFINE +3.05%. exp85b (ILP 0.4 alone) has +49 nodes and +3 forks, near-inert. (2) The node term is mechanical: +0.84% gives -0.1 x 0.91 x 0.0084 = -0.00076, the same order as R23-RC-A's -0.0005 at +0.6%. So public +0.002 = recall/edge side ~+0.0028 minus node cost ~0.0008. (3) The recall side exists only on embryos the detector never saw. The public embryo and the private embryos are all unseen (R23-RC-A: none of the 6,696 band peaks lies within 4 um of an annotated node on the train clips). So for this lever the public read is an out-of-sample measurement, on one embryo. That differs from cap 6, where each step is 1-2 fork events (R38-RC-B), and from the fork-set levers. Other out-of-sample reads are split: JT 743929 0.958 -> 0.959 on his fork, frontier947 +readmit 0.947 -> 0.946. The band population differs ~3x between train embryos (44b6 +1.09%, 6bba +0.32%). NEW VERDICT: the v3 closure stays OVERTURNED. The audit's 'public-only' label is HALF WRONG for K. Its harsh -0.001 equals K's floor (node cost with zero recall gain), not a centre. A fair private prior is ~+0.001 +- 0.0015 (half the public read, wide for the 3x embryo spread). Consequences: (a) the harsh scenario overstates V_pub's downside by ~0.001-0.002 on the K component, so the audit's medal-risk 'moderate' is if anything conservative; (b) {exp75, #37} (dropping cap 6 and K) gets less attractive than the audit's break-even suggests; (c) П3 vs П2 is unaffected (neither partner carries K; the trade is still the sign of CI on private, R37-RC-B / skeptic).

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: v3 FINAL_REPORT (e) R2 (CONTEXT l.1643-1646). The DaughterNet insertion enters the F1 stack when b >= a, and a tie counts FOR it, because 'on private the break-even is 0.11-0.20 vs 0.265 on public' (s_merge C03). Since then every final and candidate carries the insertion (#37, exp75, exp87a, exp89t), and #38 (no insertion) left the pair (R20-RC-C, R38-RC-C). WHAT CHANGED: the 13:21Z skeptic (risk_audit/skeptic.md point 4) corrected how that support was cited. The +0.0019 'honest CV' (90% CI [-0.0007, +0.0050]) came from the v1 steal sub-test at threshold 0.5 on the pre-x138 exp39 line. The shipped config uses the ensemble at threshold 0.4, the folds held out videos rather than an embryo, and the run failed its gate (added-fork precision 4/15 = 27% < 31%). FRESH CHECK: the 31% gate is P_min = max(0.15, J_pub/(1+J_pub) + 0.05), i.e. the PUBLIC floor (CONTEXT l.1321). For a low-J embryo, the break-even on the K2-stack lab is q* = J/(1+J) = 0.161 (CONTEXT l.2347; 0.114 before the insertion). A Beta(5,12) posterior on 4/15 gives 90% [0.13, 0.48], P(p < 0.114) = 0.03, P(p < 0.161) = 0.10, P(p < 0.20) = 0.20 and P(p < 0.265) = 0.42. So the insertion is ~break-even on a public-like embryo (it read +0.001 twice) and positive with P ~0.8-0.9 on a low-J embryo. The cap-4 marginal is not the problem; the cap 4 -> 6 marginal is (85 extra insertions: 0 TP / 4 FP / 81 unannotated; R39-RC-B), and that sits only in V_pub. NEW VERDICT: R2 UPHELD after the skeptic's correction. The correction lowers the weight of the +0.0019 as a number (older config), but it does not flip the sign argument: the failed gate was a public-board criterion. The insertion stays in every final, and #38 stays out. This is consistent with П3 (#37 = x138 + insertion cap 4) and П2 (exp75 = #37 + CI), both of which keep the cap-4 insertion as the private-side epsilon over the x138 copy block (407 teams at 0.953; median SubmissionCount 18).
